items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I met that guy about four months ago sleeping on the newspaper box on Canal Street.

ctx.x: And after that group get through dancing, always some guy would come in there and could tap dance. Had an old fellow there. I guess he must be now about, I know he's 70 something, they called him Fox. He used to be a great dancer too. He was born and raised over there in Al Jays across the river. Whoever Fox come in there, everybody quit dancing. And they started asking him to dance. I met that guy about four months ago sleeping on the newspaper box on Canal Street. And I knew who he was. And I was a young boy at…
All I ever knew was Fox. He lived over there in Al Jays.
